outcome: levator ani muscle (LAM) states (intact, hematoma, partial, complete avulsion)
cohort: Primiparous women who had given birth vaginally with singletons in vertex presentation at or after 36+0 gestational weeks were evaluated.
finding: The comparison between 2D and 4D translabial ultrasound showed good to very good agreement in identifying levator ani muscle trauma immediately after birth and again 6-10 weeks postpartum.
